title: RaceEvent
description: master/<event_id>/event.json: one race event. The id is the directory name; the event image is image.webp beside this file; the editions are the YYYY-MM-DD directories beside it.

name.description: Name of the event in Japanese

location.description: DEPRECATED — kept for backward compatibility. Use location_parts instead. Will be removed in a future major version.

location_parts.description: Structured location data. Required for all events.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. JP, US, ES)

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture (都道府県) for country=JP, e.g. 千葉県

region.description: Sub-national region for non-Japan countries (state, province, etc.), e.g. Texas, Catalonia

city.description: City / municipality, e.g. 木更津市, Valencia, The Woodlands

venue.description: Optional venue or sub-area detail, e.g. 中の島大橋付近, 山下公園周辺特設会場

source.description: Official website URL of the event

image_source.description: Credit of the event image (image.webp beside this file): where it comes from, its author and license.

license.description: License of the original image, e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0
